pullRequests.title: Character Pack: add pointing and sit-edge Mura poses
pullRequests.head: feature/ksyusha-pointing-sit-edge
pullRequests.body:
Implements #23 with five new AI-assisted first-party `mura.default` source poses:

- point-left / point-right / point-up / point-down
- sit-edge

The loose 192×208 8-bit RGBA PNGs are source-of-truth. `bundle-poses-c-png.cjs` mirrors the exact source bytes for the current runtime resolver. Manifest actions expose all five poses.

## Provenance
Adobe Firefly was used with the existing Mura visual identity as reference. These are new AI-assisted assets, not recovered historical illustrations. The first point-right candidate was rejected because it pointed left; the committed asset is the corrected pass. Background cleanup was repeated before import.

`sit-edge` intentionally contains no fake furniture. Its body supplies the seated anatomy (hips/knees bent, lower legs hanging); the host UI/window supplies the visible edge.

## Direct asset/pack validation performed
Because the private-repository GitHub Actions jobs received no runner (`runner_id=0`, `steps=[]` on Ubuntu/macOS/Windows), the hosted commands never started. This is an Actions-runner/quota condition, not a test assertion failure.

The branch was therefore additionally checked directly against its exact Git objects:
- all five branch blob SHAs equal the blobs created from the reviewed Adobe outputs;
- bundle base64 is byte-for-byte identical to the corresponding raw Adobe PNG for every pose;
- all five parse as 192×208, 8-bit RGBA PNG (color type 6);
- all five manifest actions resolve to the correct source filename;
- `bundle-poses-c-png.cjs` is declared in the manifest;
- new bundle/test JavaScript parses successfully.

The regression test committed in this PR repeats the PNG geometry/alpha and source-vs-bundle equality checks whenever a runner is available.

## Remaining downstream gate
FOLKOOP still must test the assets at the actual ~86–110 px helper size and on real highlighted controls. This PR does not claim that web placement is complete.

pullRequests.title: Rename flagship character identity to Mura
pullRequests.head: rename/character-to-mura
pullRequests.body:
## Canonical naming decision

**Mura is the only current character name.**

This migration changes the active repository tree and runtime surfaces to:
- Character Pack id: `mura.default`
- display name: `Mura`
- Home/renderer/runtime copy: `Mura`
- no legacy window compatibility alias
- no legacy character name in current docs, archived handoff text, tests, runtime or manifest
- naming-contract test prevents legacy names returning

Direct branch audit covered all 88 tracked text/code/config files in the current tree plus path names: **0 legacy-name hits and 0 legacy-name paths**.

Git history and old commit messages are intentionally not rewritten.

### CI note
The private-repository Actions matrix did not obtain runners: Windows/macOS/Linux jobs completed with `steps=null`. This is the same runner/quota condition recorded by the preceding Character Pack PR, not a test assertion failure. The rename is a current-tree naming migration; asset bytes and behavior are unchanged.
